data.name: Realmlords
data.detailed_description:
About This Game

Realmlords is a fast-paced action roguelite and bullet-hell / spell-hell dungeon crawler. Every run drops you into dangerous elemental realms filled with overwhelming enemy hordes, deadly hazards, powerful loot, brutal bosses, and legendary Realm Lords hunting you across the map.

Choose your class, master your weapon, and forge devastating builds through artifacts, abilities, equipment, scrolls, and upgrades. Dodge impossible odds, survive escalating chaos, clear spawner-filled arenas, defeat Portal Guardians, conquer Realm Bosses, and push deeper as difficulty spirals out of control.

FIGHT THROUGH THE REALMS

Battle across a chain of elemental worlds — Fire, Ice, Lightning, Earth, Poison, and Dark — each with unique enemies, ground hazards, bosses, and atmosphere. Every realm is built from three portal floors (1/3 → 3/3). Clear spawners, defeat the Portal Guardian, collect progression relics, and advance toward the Realm Boss at the end of each realm cycle.

Push far enough and unlock Realm Lord X — the ultimate difficulty tier where loot becomes god-tier, danger becomes lethal, and only the strongest builds survive.

12 UNIQUE CLASSES

Play as one of 12 distinct classes, each with unique strengths, stat scaling, and combat identity:

  • Warrior

  • Wizard

  • Archer

  • Paladin (starts with Reflect Shield)

  • Rogue

  • Druid

  • Dwarf Warrior

  • Gnome Wizard

  • Orc Wizard

  • Red Wizard

  • Necromancer

  • Bard

Whether you prefer crushing melee, precision ranged combat, spellcasting, summoning, support, or hybrid builds — every class offers a different path through the realms.

WEAPONS, GEAR & BUILD CRAFTING

Begin each run by choosing a starting weapon and grow into something monstrous:

Weapon Archetypes

  • Sword · Staff · Axe · Mace · Dagger · Shuriken · Trident · Bow · Boomerang · Wand

  • Musical Instruments (Bard — Lute, Flute, Drum)

Combat Gear

  • Full armor and accessory loot with randomized stats and rarities

  • One-handed and two-handed weapons — 1H attacks faster; 2H hits harder and blocks shield use

  • Shields with Block Chance — block physical and elemental hits when your resistances align

  • Magic Focus off-hand items for caster classes

  • Dual-wield for Warrior, Dwarf Warrior, and Rogue — alternating strikes with both weapons

Build Systems

  • Level up and choose from a huge pool of active and passive abilities

  • Collect scroll fragments, craft Skill Books, and unlock new powers mid-run

  • Equip Realm Boss artifacts on a dedicated hotbar for devastating activated skills

  • Temper gear at the anvil with mined ore for permanent item upgrades

  • Gamble unwanted loot for better gear — manually or with auto-gamble while you fight

ELEMENTAL COMBAT & ABILITIES

Realmlords is built for players who love screen-filling combat:

  • Fire, ice, lightning, earth, poison, holy, and dark projectiles and effects

  • Mana Surge — unleash oversized elemental attacks using your equipped weapon or spell type

  • Orbitals, whirlwinds, familiars, auras, beams, and more

  • Reflect Shield — orbit shields that bounce enemy projectiles back for full damage

  • Enemy spawners, pillars, blade traps, lava pools, poison hazards, and boss summon rituals

  • Rare, elemental, and boss enemies with escalating patterns and loot tables

REALM LORDS — THE ULTIMATE THREAT

Seven unique Realm Lords stalk the dungeon — one of each type per map, never duplicated. They are immune to all damage unless you wield a Legendary weapon earned on Realm Lord X difficulty.

Hunt them down, survive their assault, and claim massive rewards — if your build is ready.

REALM ANGER & HOARD WAVES

Grind too long and the realm fights back.

The Realm Anger Bar rises as you kill enemies, break spawners, open chests, destroy pillars, and mine ore. Hit 100% and the realm unleashes a Hoard Wave — a punishing surge of enemies that grows exponentially each time it triggers within a realm.

Anger persists across portal floors and resets when you conquer a realm and move on. It’s a pacing system designed to reward progression and punish stalling.

LOOT, LORE & LONG-TERM PROGRESSION

During Runs

  • Gold, keys, potions, food, hourglasses, magnets, and chests of every tier

  • Orbs and relics that unlock the next realm in your journey

  • Gear scaling with 10 difficulty tiers from Normal I through Realm Lord X

Between Runs

  • Character profiles that save your roster, difficulty unlocks, and progress

  • Lore Fragments — permanent account currency used in the Lore Archive to reveal the Realmlords story sentence by sentence

  • Achievements tracking kills, bosses, realms, lore chapters, and more

  • Steam Leaderboards to compete for high scores and realm-clear times

CO-OP MULTIPLAYER

Team up with friends in online co-op. Share the same dungeon layout, fight the same bosses, pool progression drops, and survive the hoard together. Greater Mana Surge can link players for coordinated burst damage.

KEY FEATURES

  • Fast-paced action roguelite gameplay with high replayability

  • Intense bullet-hell and spell-hell combat

  • 12 playable classes with unique bonuses and playstyles

  • 11 weapon archetypes and countless build combinations

  • 6+ elemental realms with unique enemies, bosses, and hazards

  • 3 portal floors per realm → Portal Guardian → Realm Boss progression

  • 7 unique Realm Lords and the Realm Lord X endgame difficulty

  • Realm Anger anti-grind system and escalating Hoard Waves

  • Deep loot: gear, artifacts, abilities, scrolls, ore, tempering, and gambling

  • Lore Archive, achievements, and Steam leaderboards

  • Online co-op multiplayer (Alpha) (Working Version Coming Soon)

  • Procedural dungeons, randomized loot, and endless build experimentation

JOIN THE COMMUNITY

Report bugs, share builds, discuss strategies, and stay up to date with future updates.

The realms are watching. How long can you survive?

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4460 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 960 / AMD RX 570 / Intel Arc A380
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 300 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX Compatible Sound Card
  • VR Support: None
  • Additional Notes: SSD recommended. Keyboard and mouse required.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 Version 1909 or newer
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4460 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 960 / AMD RX 570 / Intel Arc A380
  • Storage: 300 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX Compatible Sound Card
  • VR Support: None
  • Additional Notes: SSD recommended. Keyboard and mouse required.
